story.title: India's quiet supercomputer milestone

scenes.headline: The machines behind India's next discoveries.
scenes.subhead: A quieter story about computing power.
scenes.narration: India is quietly building computers for tomorrow's scientific discoveries.

scenes.headline: Indian-designed computing power
scenes.note: Used in PARAM Rudra supercomputing systems
scenes.narration: As of September twenty twenty-six, six thousand India-designed Rudra servers had been deployed in PARAM Rudra supercomputers.

scenes.headline: More servers are on the way
scenes.narration: Another fifteen hundred servers were under manufacturing, according to the same government briefing.

scenes.headline: What can they help scientists do?
scenes.subhead: Sophisticated simulations can support important scientific work.
scenes.narration: Supercomputers help researchers tackle complex problems in weather, new materials, genomics and drug discovery.

scenes.headline: Millions of compute jobs
scenes.note: The figure is broader than Rudra servers alone.
scenes.narration: Across the wider National Supercomputing Mission, infrastructure has executed more than fifteen million computing jobs.

scenes.headline: More tools for the next breakthrough.
scenes.subhead: A stronger research foundation is the real story.
scenes.narration: The real story is domestic research capacity: more powerful tools for future breakthroughs.
